about: What a RetroArch core needs that the defaults don't give (src/detect.c, add_core_platforms), on both consoles.
Each rule matches a core by its name ("names", exact, any case, or "contains") and, when given, the system it plays
("systems", the first slug of detect.c's DB_MAP). The first rule that matches adds its "entry" keys to the core's
platform entry (src/profiles.h: save_exts, save_name, save_stems, save_format, save_layout, disc_id, memcards, cards).
Defaults: saves <save folder>/<game>.srm (.sav, .rtc), states <state folder>/<game>.state*. "note" is for docs/emulators.md.
"apart": the core's saves are a kind of their own. Its keys never go on the system's entry, whichever core plays it; a twin
of the core's own (src/profiles.c) syncs them, in a slot of its own (<slot>-<core id>).

rules.note: Per game: <save folder>/<game>.ps2 (slot 1 only). Shared (the default): <system>/pcsx2/memcards/Mcd001.ps2 and Mcd002.ps2.

cards.change: Turn off Shared Memory Cards in LRPS2's core options

rules.note: One per game (the default): <game>.ps2 in <system>/pcsx2/memcards, named in <system>/ps5sx2/gamesettings/<serial>_<crc>.ini, which RomM Sync writes. Shared: Mcd001.ps2 and Mcd002.ps2 there.
Card 1: <game>.srm (Libretro, the default), <serial>_1.mcd (per game by code) or <game>_1.mcd (by title). Shared: duckstation_shared_card_1.mcd.

cards.change: Set Memory Card 1 Type to Libretro in SwanStation's core options

rules.note: Card 1: <game>.srm. Shared cards (mednafen_psx_libretro_shared.N.mcr) need the Mednafen card method.

cards.change: Turn off Shared Memory Cards in the core options

rules.note: <save folder>/<game>.srm: the raw cartridge save, the same as standalone melonDS's .sav (PS5-ECAM), so the two share one.
<save folder>/<game>.dsv: the cartridge save with DeSmuME's footer after it. The save alone goes to RomM and the others (melonDS DS, PS5-ECAM); the footer is put back for DeSmuME.
<save folder>/<game>.srm: the cartridge's SRAM, the same as Snes9x PS5's, so they share one.
<save folder>/<game>.srm: the save RAM, the same as Beetle PCE PS5's, so they share one.
<save folder>/<game>.srm: the cartridge's SRAM (without its trailing blank bytes), the same save as Genesis Plus GX PS5's 64 KB one, so they share one.
<save folder>/<game>.srm: the cartridge's SRAM, the same as GBCXY's .sav, so they share one. The clock (.rtc) stays on each console.
Shared (the default): <system>/dc/vmu_save_<port>.bin. Per-Game VMUs on VMU A1 or All VMUs: <save folder>/<disc id>.A1.bin (<game>.A1.bin before late 2024), the same raw 128 KB card as PSFlyCast's.

cards.change: Set Per-Game VMUs to VMU A1 in Flycast's core options

rules.note: Beetle Saturn: internal backup memory as <game>.srm (its Libretro save method, the default) or <game>.bkr; the cartridge's as <game>.bcr.

cards.change: Turn off Shared Internal and Backup Memory in Beetle Saturn's core options

rules.note: Controller paks live in each game's .srm (EEPROM, four paks, SRAM, flash): there's no shared one.
A GCI folder: one file per save, so each game's own; synced as a zip of the game's .gci files.

Each game's NVRAM folder, <save folder>/mame/nvram/<set>/, synced as a zip of it (<set>.zip), the same as standalone MAME's, in a slot of its own (autosave-mame). The arcade entry's .srm saves sync as before, whichever core plays them.
